name: Camel
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 9 and Stealth 10. No listed special senses. No listed languages.
appearance: A sandy-coated dromedary with one shaggy hump, a long arched neck, a split upper lip, and broad two-toed pads.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, page 354. XP follows the CR table on page 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR +2, DEX +0, CON +2, INT −4, WIS −1, CHA −3. Use these modifiers and the fixed Black Flag Perception and Stealth values.
sections.Traits: Camel Resilience. The camel needs half the water of a typical Beast its size. It is resistant to exhaustion, which gives it advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end that condition.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one creature. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Bile Spit. Ranged weapon attack, +2 to hit with range 20/60 ft. against one creature. Hit for 2 (1d4) acid damage. The target then makes a DC 12 Constitution save or becomes smelly for 1 hour or until a creature spends 1 minute cleaning off the spit. While smelly, the target has disadvantage on Charisma checks.

name: Frog
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 11 and Stealth 10. Darkvision 30 ft. No listed languages.
appearance: A compact pond frog with a broad blunt head, amber eyes, smooth olive-brown skin, and folded, powerful hind legs.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, page 357. XP follows the CR table on page 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR −5, DEX +0, CON −1, INT −5, WIS −1, CHA −4. Use these modifiers and the fixed Black Flag Perception and Stealth values.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The frog breathes in air and water.
Standing Leap. Long jump up to 10 ft. and high jump up to 5 ft., with or without a running start.
Condition resistance. Advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the grappled condition.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one creature. Hit for 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Goat
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 10 and Stealth 10. No listed special senses. No listed languages.
appearance: A wiry cream-and-gray goat with a short beard, narrow swept horns, horizontal pupils, and split hooves.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, pages 358–359. XP follows the CR table on page 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR +1, DEX +0, CON +0, INT −4, WIS +0, CHA −3. Use these modifiers and the fixed Black Flag Perception and Stealth values.
sections.Traits:
Condition resistance. Advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the prone condition.
Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit with Ram on the same turn. The hit deals an extra 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it also makes a DC 11 Strength save or falls prone.
sections.Actions: Ram. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. Hit for 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Terrifying Scream. When the goat takes damage, each creature within 10 ft. that hears the scream must make a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened until the end of its next turn. A creature frightened this way cannot be frightened by this goat’s Terrifying Scream again for 24 hours.

name: Hawk
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 14 and Stealth 11. No listed special senses. No listed languages.
appearance: A compact brown hawk with broad shoulders, a cream breast, hooked gray beak, and curved talons.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, page 359. XP follows the CR table on page 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR −3, DEX +1, CON −1, INT −4, WIS +2, CHA −2. Use these modifiers and the fixed Black Flag Perception and Stealth values.
sections.Traits: Heightened Sight. Use Perception 19 when the hawk relies on sight.
sections.Actions: Talons. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. Hit for 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Evasive Flight. The hawk takes the Disengage or Dodge action as a bonus action while flying.
